name: Gishora Drum Sanctuary
subtitle: A royal field near Gitega, Burundi. Card in preparation.

parts.text: Gishora is a field about 7 km north of Gitega, in Gitega Province, Burundi. Wikipedia says it houses a royal palace and a royal field.

gaps: Almost everything. The famous royal drummers, the sanctuary's history and its place on UNESCO's intangible heritage list are not covered by the short article read here; they must be sourced from UNESCO and from Burundian voices.
This place was chosen by the project as one of Burundi's best known; Burundi has no site on the World Heritage List.
